evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, or rule with creating a new game and providing optional description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a conflicting invitation mechanism or prohibits URL-based invites.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on how a round item must be entered.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids viewing the session's items or imposes an incompatible rule.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a conflicting constraint on selecting items for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits adding new items or imposes an incompatible rule.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint preventing editing of items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires keeping every item or conflicts with deletion of items.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This conflicts with PP-033 which requires estimates to be shown only after all estimators have given their estimate (incompatible behavior about when estimates are revealed).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates an incompatible decision rule for accepting estimates.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a conflicting rule that would forbid auto-filling the estimate field in this condition.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on entering agreed estimates.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids re-estimating previously estimated stories; behavior is compatible.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on importing stories from spreadsheets.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No other story conflicts with allowing copy/paste import of stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits browsing stored games; deletion story (PP-020) only removes deleted games, which is not contradictory.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is not inherently inconsistent with other stories; none require transcripts to be stored only anonymously in a way that forbids viewing story/estimate content.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts does not conflict with other stories; storage/anonymization requirements are not specified to forbid exports.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule that would prevent exporting transcripts as CSV; anonymity requirements can be satisfied without contradiction.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deleting stored games is not incompatible with other stories; it simply affects persistence and does not contradict any mandatory requirement to keep all data forever.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is not inconsistent with any other story; other stories do not mandate account-only access exclusively.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login behavior does not conflict with any other story's permissions or rules.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on changing account details.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion does not conflict with other stories; no other story requires accounts to remain undeleted.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a conflicting timezone policy or prohibits local timezone display.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or constraints.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a single fixed card set that would conflict with letting the moderator choose between sequences.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a different maximum that would be incompatible with this cap.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining by entering a name at the URL does not conflict with other stories (accounts are optional elsewhere).

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule preventing participants from seeing the current item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids viewing the session's item list; behavior is compatible.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: This indicates presence of an estimate (not its value) and does not conflict with the rule about revealing estimate values simultaneously (PP-033).

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This conflicts with PP-009, which allows the moderator to show all estimates immediately before all estimators have given their estimate (incompatible behaviors about reveal timing).

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on when participants can change estimates; this is consistent with PP-041.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids viewing prior estimates; storage/anonymity requirements do not explicitly forbid showing prior estimates in-session.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Displaying who gave which estimate in-session does not conflict with other stories; it may be session-only and not require persistent identifiable storage.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a conflicting requirement on timers or their visibility.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible timer behavior; this complements the general timer story.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids reviewing prior rounds; behavior is compatible with exports and transcripts.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires cards to be reordered per draw; no incompatibility detected.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This is consistent with PP-034's more specific condition and does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail in-session does not conflict with other stories; anonymity for stored results (PP-052) can be implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is not incompatible with any other functional or behavioral story.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions doesn't conflict with other stories; it supports consistency.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related developer work does not conflict with other functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Supporting older browsers does not impose an incompatible constraint with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility goals do not conflict with other stories; they complement them.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation does not conflict with other functional requirements.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support does not conflict with any other story's constraints.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design preference does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or permissions.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: User-friendly error pages do not impose incompatible constraints with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing results non-identifiably can be implemented alongside in-session identity displays and transcript exports via anonymization; no story explicitly requires persistent identifiable storage that directly contradicts this.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics requirements do not conflict with other stories; they can be implemented without imposing incompatible rules.
